_disclaimer: App availability verified on device operating systems running the latest public firmware.

devices.name: Roku (Streaming Sticks & Roku TV)
devices.setupTips: Ensure OS 12.0 or higher. For optimum 4K live sports playback, use 5GHz Wi-Fi or an Ethernet adapter on Roku Ultra.

devices.name: Amazon Fire TV (Stick & Omni TV)
devices.setupTips: Fire OS offers deep Alexa voice remote integration. You can say 'Alexa, tune to ESPN on YouTube TV' directly.

devices.name: Apple TV (4K & HD)
devices.setupTips: Fubo and YouTube TV both offer advanced multi-view features specifically optimized for the Apple TV A15 Bionic processor.

devices.name: Google TV & Chromecast
devices.setupTips: The 'Live' tab on the Google TV home screen integrates YouTube TV and Sling TV channels directly into the system guide.

devices.name: Samsung Smart TV (Tizen OS)
devices.setupTips: Available on 2017+ Tizen models. Use the Samsung Smart Hub to pin your live streaming service to the first app slot.

devices.name: LG Smart TV (webOS)
devices.setupTips: Compatible with webOS 4.0+. Philo and Frndly TV require an external streaming stick on select LG models.

devices.name: Vizio SmartCast
devices.setupTips: Direct apps available on SmartCast homescreen or stream via built-in Chromecast & Apple AirPlay.

devices.name: Xbox (Series X/S & Xbox One)
devices.setupTips: Download directly from Microsoft Store. Supports background app switching during gaming sessions.

devices.name: PlayStation 5 & PS4
devices.setupTips: Locate under the Media hub tab. Sling and Fubo do not currently maintain native PlayStation apps.

devices.name: iPhone & iPad (iOS / iPadOS)
devices.setupTips: Supports picture-in-picture (PiP) background playback and AirPlay casting to any AirPlay 2-compatible receiver.

devices.name: Android Phones & Tablets
devices.setupTips: All major providers support Google Cast and PiP mode for watching live sports while multi-tasking.
